text: Question for story-engine: in our 8-beat arcs the resolution beat sits on page 6-7 (succeed/restore on 7 per PROSE_PRODUCTION_GUIDE), so the most intense page is likely already in the last third. Content can annotate intensity per variant if an audit needs it. For bedtime the 'peak' should be low and early-ish so pages 7-8 descend; we would not want a bedtime arc tuned toward a late peak.
